notes.title: What's new in the Steam edition:
notes.content:
[list][*]Steam achievements (including 6 completely new ones)[/*][*]Steam trading cards[/*][*]extra stories unlock after certain endings[/*][*]updated graphics[/*][*]a new unlockable minigame[/*][*]some new NPCs[/*][*]minor bug fixes and improvements[/*][*]a mac version is now available[/*][*]a German version is now available[/*][/list]* Note: the promo video still features the old graphics.

If you have previously purchased the non-Steam version of Princess Battles from our website, you can use the [url=http://www.princess-battles.com/support.php]contact form[/url] to send your receipt / order information and we will send you a Steam key.
